**brief:** The relevance gate no longer closes plain-language prompts as `index_stale` after a commit. It judged freshness by the base shard's commit, which only a rebuild moves; it now uses the HEAD the index covers, which the daemon advances when it catches up with a commit, checkout or pull. On the public bench, after one commit: 10/56 prompts closed as stale before, 0/56 after.
